title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (.moeb/README.md first attempt)
description: First patch_file call on .moeb/README.md failed with 'error applying hunk #1 — diff context lines may not match the current file content'. The operation succeeded on retry with corrected context anchoring. The file is in the correct state.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why the first patch context did not match. The moeb patch_file context-relocate spec should handle this; the failure may indicate the hunk header line numbers were too far off for relocation to find the correct anchor.

title: moeb-tool-origin: Read and ToolSearch used without MissingMoebTool signals
description: The Read tool was used 4 times (event file + 3 chunks of start_spec tool output) and ToolSearch was used 2 times (loading MCP tool schemas). No MissingMoebTool signals were buffered for either. These are external tools not in the moeb registry.
proposed_resolution: Buffer MissingMoebTool signals for Read (file reading outside moeb registry) and ToolSearch (MCP tool schema loading) at the point of use in future spec sessions.

title: start_spec tool output exceeds max tokens — requires external Read chunking
description: The start_spec tool result was saved to an external file and required 3 chunked Read calls to retrieve, forcing use of an external tool. A moeb-native paginated read or summary-truncation mechanism would eliminate this external dependency.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a paginated read tool or a start_spec output size limit that fits within a single tool result.

title: No moeb tool for loading MCP tool schemas (ToolSearch)
description: ToolSearch was required to load MCP tool parameter schemas before they could be called. This is a Claude Code MCP session bootstrapping step with no moeb equivalent.
proposed_resolution: Consider whether a moeb tool can surface available tool schemas, or document that ToolSearch is an acceptable bootstrapping exception in the moeb-tool-origin policy.
